source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.6.2 (Preparation of Alkenes), printed pages 255-256.

blocks.text: Alkenes saturated compounds ke saath saath wale (adjacent) carbon atoms se chhote atoms (H, OH, X) hata kar banaye jate hain, taake carbon atoms ke darmiyan double bond ban jaye. Inhen elimination reactions (hatane wali reactions) kehte hain. In reactions mein organic molecule ke saath wale carbons se H₂O ya HCl jaisa chhota molecule nikal jata hai. Neeche ethene banane ke tareeqe diye gaye hain.
Ethanol aur zyada miqdar mein concentrated (gaarhe) sulphuric acid ke mixture ko 180°C par garam karne se ethene banti hai. Is reaction mein alcohol molecule se pani ka aik molecule nikal jata hai.
Pehle step mein ethyl hydrogen sulphate banta hai, jo garam karne par toot kar ethene deta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Sulphuric acid aakhir mein wapas mil jata hai (doosre equation mein H₂SO₄ dobara banta hai), is liye kul mila kar sirf ethanol se pani nikla: C₂H₅OH → C₂H₄ + H₂O.
ii) Alkyl halides ki dehydrohalogenation (hydrogen aur halogen nikalna)
Ethyl bromide ko alcoholic KOH ke saath garam karne se ethene banti hai. Saath wale carbon atoms se aik hydrogen aur aik halogen nikal jate hain aur double bond ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Propanol ki H₂SO₄ ke saath reactions aur bromopropane ki dehydrohalogenation likhein (Quick Check 11.4a, d, e).
blocks.explanation: Propan-1-ol concentrated sulphuric acid ke saath pehle propyl hydrogen sulphate banata hai: CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + H₂SO₄ → CH₃CH₂CH₂OSO₃H + H₂O. Garam karne par yeh toot kar propene deta hai: CH₃CH₂CH₂OSO₃H → CH₃CH=CH₂ + H₂SO₄. Kul mila kar yeh dehydration hai, is liye haan, propanol ki dehydration ho sakti hai. 1-Bromopropane garam alcoholic KOH ke saath HBr khota hai: CH₃CH₂CH₂Br + KOH → CH₃CH=CH₂ + KBr + H₂O.

items: Elimination saath wale carbons se chhota molecule (H₂O, HX) nikal kar C=C banati hai.
Ethene: ethanol + concentrated H₂SO₄ 180 °C par (ethyl hydrogen sulphate ke zariye); bromoethane + alcoholic KOH, garmi.
